complete_examples.text: With novelty, the geometric nonlinearity of curved rail beam and mechanical nonlinearity of ballasted bed lateral resistance have been fully considered.

For example, Lei and Feng [11] established a two-dimensional continuously welded rail finite element model considering the nonlinearity ballasted bed lateral resistance, in which the effect of curved radius, invalid tie, and the misalignment defect on the stability of continuous weld rail (CWR) has been clarified.
